summary: Top KingWin Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting the closing of a disposition. Its wholly-owned indirect subsidiary Sky KingWin (HK) sold its subsidiary Guangdong Tiancheng Jinhui Enterprise Development Group Co., Ltd. to Junze Management Co., Limited for $218,100 cash. The transaction closed on June 18, 2026, after all conditions were satisfied. No board recommendation or advisor was disclosed. The buyer is unaffiliated. Following closing, the buyer assumed all assets and liabilities. This is a small divestiture; watch for any subsequent restructuring or strategic pivot by the registrant.
